prompt: Create a crisp detailed pixel-art sprite animation sheet for Agents Bar, matching silver-blue, warm gold, deep navy medieval fantasy materials. TRUE frame-by-frame shapes changing, no merely translated or recolored copies. Exactly FOUR columns and FOUR rows, sixteen equal square cells, one animation per row, four successive frames left to right. Transparent alpha-zero background. No text, no labels, no frames, no checkerboard. Each cell has 15% empty padding on every edge; keep the whole effect inside its cell, with constant scale. No characters, only standalone combat effects. Row1 sword slash: short silver crescent, wide arc, split arc with streaks, fading small streaks. Row2 impact: tiny gold spark, eight pointed star burst, expanding fragmented burst, scattered small embers. Row3 block: blue shield arc appears, compresses under contact, fractures outward, dissipates. Row4 damage: red sharp flash grows, jagged red burst, fragments fly apart, faint red dots.
